1_forcedprovisional_findings: None. No findings met the blocked_url_index_verified standard. The one candidate (Apestan.com Case 83175) was disqualified on three grounds: outside time window, site permanently defunct, and text visible only via Google search snippet (not Google cache or valid mirror of same URL).
2_degradations_and_verification_decision: **F-04 (SimilarWeb engagement metrics):** Retained in Part 1 despite own fetch truncation at token limit. Verbatim sourced from research subagent who directly fetched the same URL (https://www.similarweb.com/website/kichink.com/). The engagement metrics (bounce rate, pages/visit, avg duration) are standard SimilarWeb page elements that always appear in the same section. Conservative approach would degrade to Part 4, but subagent's direct access was confirmed via the same URL, and the data type is deterministic (not subject to rendering variation). Decision: retained as direct_verified with this note.
3_multispeaker_splits: Not applicable. No multi-speaker buyer-voice pages were accessed. The one multi-speaker candidate (Promodescuentos discussion with 7 comments) was inaccessible (403 Forbidden).
4_truncated_sources:
**SimilarWeb (https://www.similarweb.com/website/kichink.com/):** Own fetch truncated at approximately 5,000 tokens, capturing page header through "Total Visits 32.2K" but not engagement metrics, geographic section, or audience interests. Research subagent captured the complete page including engagement metrics, geographic distribution, audience interests, and competitors section. Findings F-01 through F-04 use data from both own fetch (ranking data, total visits) and subagent fetch (prose sentences, engagement metrics).

**Kichink Terms page (https://www.kichink.com/legales/terminos):** Returned 403 Forbidden on direct fetch. Content partially visible in Google search results. Not used as a finding source because: (a) search snippet text is not equivalent to direct access or valid mirror; (b) Terms and Conditions describe platform mechanisms available to buyers, not observed buyer behavior — outside D4 scope.
5_source_type_ambiguities:
**ScamAdviser (F-X14):** Classified as out-of-scope because it is an automated website trust-score tool that does not fit any allowed source_type. Closest candidate would be "report" but ScamAdviser is an algorithmic output, not a human-authored analytical report.

**SimilarWeb (F-01 through F-04):** Classified as "report." SimilarWeb is a third-party analytics platform providing estimated traffic data through proprietary modeling. While the data is machine-generated (not human-authored analysis), it is a published analytical data product from a recognized industry analytics source. "Report" is the closest fit among allowed source_types and aligns with the shard's qualifiers-to-preserve list, which specifically requests "aggregate stats with source" from third-party analytics sources.
6_coverage_gaps:
**(a) No buyer-voice data from any source in the target window.** This is a genuine gap reflecting Kichink's near-absent buyer footprint in public discourse, not a research failure. All available buyer-adjacent content (complaints, reviews, social media posts) is either seller-voice or outside the April 2025–April 2026 window.

**(b) No conversion rate, AOV, or cart abandonment data.** No third-party source publishes these metrics for Kichink. SimilarWeb's free tier provides traffic and engagement but not e-commerce-specific conversion metrics.

**(c) Promodescuentos discussion inaccessible.** The page at https://www.promodescuentos.com/discusiones/es-seguro-comprar-en-kichinkcom-alguien-ha-comprado-ahi-409462 (7 comments, title suggests buyer-relevant content) returned 403 Forbidden. Content and date unknown. No archive.org or Google cache alternative was found.

**(d) Apestan.com historical database permanently lost.** The Apestan.com domain has been converted to a for-sale page (Wix). The site historically hosted buyer and seller complaints about Kichink, including at least one confirmed buyer-voice complaint (Case 83175). The entire complaint database is now inaccessible.

**(e) Twitter/X search not directly accessible.** Twitter/X search (https://twitter.com/search?q=...) requires JavaScript rendering and authentication. Research relied on `site:x.com` and `site:twitter.com` Google web searches, which may not capture all tweets, particularly recent ones not yet indexed by Google.

**(f) Kichink.com homepage returned 403** on own direct fetch but was reported as accessible by research subagents (displaying @2025 copyright, product listings, and store names). Discrepancy may be due to rate limiting, geographic IP filtering, or timing. Site operational status not treated as a finding since it is platform infrastructure, not buyer behavior.
7_decomposition_issues: SD-08 (conversion rate / AOV / cart abandonment) was unlikely to return results given the platform's apparent minimal activity, but was included for completeness per the shard's qualifiers-to-preserve list. No third-party analytics service publishes e-commerce-specific metrics for Kichink at the free/public tier.
8_timewindow_boundary: SimilarWeb data (F-01 through F-04) is dated March 2026 per page title, which falls within the April 2025–April 2026 window. The ranking trend references a three-month period (approximately January–March 2026), fully within the window. SimilarWeb updates its data dynamically; the page was titled "[March 2026]" at time of access (April 2026).
9_sellervoice_exclusions:
Extensive seller-voice content was found during research but excluded per D4 direction rules (buyer-speaker test). Key exclusions:
- #KichinkNoPaga movement tweets and articles (seller payment disputes, 2019–2020)
- Change.org petition (seller-organized)
- Protest store pages on kichink.com itself (e.g., /stores/kichinkesunaestafa)
- Isopixel, Expansión, El CEO, Quinta Fuerza, Dinero en Imagen, Techie.mx, MarketHax, Contxto articles (all seller-voice)
- Facebook videos by Trendo.mx and Lalo Villar (seller experience)
- Seller tweet quoting "Dejen de comprar por favor en @Kichink" — seller addressing buyers, not buyer's own words

One borderline case: Quinta Fuerza article states "Además usuarios también acusan de no entregar los pedidos realizados a través de dicha plataforma." This is a journalist's summary without quoting a specific buyer. "Usuarios" in context likely includes both sellers and buyers. No specific buyer is quoted. Excluded as insufficient buyer-voice attribution and outside time window (2020).
10_output_shape_assessment: Final shape: **4 clean, 0 provisional, 15 could_not_verify.** Expected: 2–5 clean, 3–6 provisional, 10–15 could_not_verify. Clean count (4) is within expected range. Provisional count (0) is below expected range (3–6) — this reflects the genuine absence of sources meeting the blocked_url_index_verified standard, not a verification bar issue. Could_not_verify count (15) is at the top of expected range, consistent with the task's prediction that "Direction is heavy on Part 4" and that "Kichink has very limited public buyer voice in 2025-2026."
